title: 第7章 雷霆万钧第8章 又下药
slug: 纯阳霸体绝美师尊求与我修炼
content_zh:
擂台上，秦天霸那面庞愈发狰狞扭曲，丑得令人咋舌。
身形更是膨胀得如同远古凶兽降世，哪还有半分人形。
他嘴角勾起一抹邪笑，眼中满是不屑，直直盯着苏铭，声音尖锐而傲慢：“苏铭，今日便是你的死期！前几日你给我的耻辱，我定要亲手将你碾碎，方能解我心头之恨！”
说罢，秦天霸周身气势陡然攀升，凝气境七层的恐怖气息四溢开来，犹如风暴席卷擂台。
台下众人见状，瞬间哗然。
“我的天呐，这秦天霸之前不是才凝气四层吗？怎么一下子飙升到七层了？”
“这也太夸张了吧，这实力提升得简直匪夷所思！”
“如此一来，那跟他决斗的苏铭可就悬了，根本不是对手啊！”
众人交头接耳，纷纷摇头，对苏铭的胜算已然不抱任何希望。
而苏铭，此刻面色平静，眼神深邃，心中暗自思忖：“这秦天霸果然有古怪，实力提升如此迅猛，定有蹊跷。不过，想碾碎我，怕也没那么容易！”
苏铭一步跨上擂台，周身雷霆瞬间翻涌，仿若一尊雷帝降世。
“今日，便让你见识下，何为雷霆万钧！”苏铭暴喝一声，整个人化作一道雷光，朝着秦天霸迅猛冲去。
雷光所至之处，擂台之上的青石纷纷炸裂，烟尘滚滚。
秦天霸见状，脸色瞬间变得煞白，想要躲避，却发现雷光速度太快，根本避无可避。
眨眼间，苏铭已杀至秦天霸身前，他猛地挥出一拳，拳头上雷光缠绕，恰似一条雷龙在咆哮。
“轰！”这一拳重重地砸在秦天霸胸口，秦天霸整个人如断了线的风筝一般，倒飞出去数丈之远，口中鲜血狂喷。
“啊！”秦天霸发出一声惨叫，在地上挣扎着想要爬起来，却发现全身剧痛，根本使不上力气。
苏铭却没有丝毫停手的意思，他脚踏雷光，再次冲向秦天霸，每一步落下，擂台都剧烈颤抖，仿若承受不住他的威压。
“雷霆之怒，万钧之力，给我灭！”苏铭双手结印，无数道雷光从他手中射出，如一道道利箭，将秦天霸彻底笼罩。
秦天霸在雷光中拼命挣扎，发出一声声惨叫，身上的衣物被雷光撕碎，皮肤也被电得焦黑，模样凄惨至极。

“不，不要打了，我认输，我认输啊！”秦天霸终于承受不住，大声求饶起来，声音中满是恐惧与绝望。
苏铭面色冷冽如霜，眼神中没有丝毫怜悯，寒声道：“哼，这是生死斗，可没有求饶一说！”
说罢，苏铭手中雷光愈发强盛，他一步一步走向秦天霸，准备给予其最后一击。
秦天霸看着一步步逼近的苏铭，吓得屁滚尿流，双腿发软，连爬都爬不动了，只能瘫在地上，惊恐地看着苏铭。
就在这时，一道愤怒的声音从台下传来：“苏铭，你给我住手！”
众人望去，只见秦家的家主秦阳明正满脸怒容地站在台下，双眼仿佛要喷出火来，死死地盯着苏铭。
苏铭听到声音，只是冷冷地瞥了秦阳明一眼，根本不为所动，手中的雷光反而变得更加狂暴。
“秦阳明，今日他必死，天王老子来了也救不了他！”苏铭声音冰冷，仿若从九幽地狱传来，透着一股决然。
“你敢！你若敢杀了他，我秦家定让你苏家鸡犬不宁！”秦阳明怒不可遏，咆哮道。
苏铭嘴角勾起一抹嘲讽的笑意，不屑道：“就凭你秦家？我苏铭还从未怕过！”
言罢，苏铭不再犹豫，手中雷光轰然爆发，如一道通天光柱，朝着秦天霸狠狠砸下。
“轰！”一声巨响，擂台瞬间被炸得粉碎，烟尘弥漫，碎石飞溅。
待烟尘散去，只见秦天霸已气息全无，倒在一片废墟之中，死状惨烈。
周围的人看到这一幕，皆是震惊得说不出话来，一个个瞪大了眼睛，满脸不可思议。
林家众人亦是纷纷震动，林家家主一脸惊异，喃喃自语道：“这个苏家废柴大少爷，竟然藏得这么深……”
content_en:
On the ring, Qin Tianba's face became more and more ferocious and twisted, and it was staggeringly ugly.
The body shape is even more swollen, like an ancient ferocious beast coming to the world, and it is not even half human.
An evil smile appeared on the corner of his mouth, his eyes were full of disdain, and he stared straight at Su Ming. His voice was sharp and arrogant: "Su Ming, today is the day you die! The shame you gave me a few days ago, I must crush you with my own hands to relieve the hatred in my heart!"
After saying that, Qin Tianba's aura suddenly rose, and the terrifying aura from the seventh level of Qi Condensation Realm overflowed, like a storm sweeping across the arena.
When everyone in the audience saw this, they were instantly in an uproar.
"Oh my god, wasn't Qin Tianba only at the fourth level of Qi Condensation before? Why did he suddenly reach the seventh level?"
"This is too exaggerated. This increase in strength is simply unbelievable!"
"In this case, Su Ming, who is dueling with him, will be in trouble. He is no match at all!"
Everyone whispered to each other and shook their heads, no longer having any hope for Su Ming's chances of winning.
And Su Ming, with a calm face and deep eyes at the moment, was thinking to himself: "This Qin Tianba is really weird. His strength has increased so rapidly, so there must be something fishy about it. However, it's not that easy to crush me!"
Su Ming stepped onto the ring in one step, and thunder surged around him instantly, as if a thunder emperor had come to the world.
"Today, I will show you what thunder means!" Su Ming shouted loudly, and his whole body turned into a bolt of lightning and rushed towards Qin Tianba.
Wherever the lightning struck, the bluestones on the arena exploded and smoke billowed.
When Qin Tianba saw this, his face instantly turned pale. He wanted to avoid it, but found that the speed of the lightning was too fast and there was no way to avoid it.
In the blink of an eye, Su Ming was in front of Qin Tianba. He punched out violently, and lightning wrapped around his fist, like a thunder dragon roaring.
"Boom!" This punch hit Qin Tianba's chest hard. Qin Tianba flew backwards several feet away like a kite with its string broken, and blood spurted out from his mouth.
"Ah!" Qin Tianba screamed and struggled on the ground to get up, but found that his whole body was in severe pain and he couldn't use any strength at all.
However, Su Ming had no intention of stopping. He stepped on the lightning and rushed towards Qin Tianba again. With every step he took, the arena trembled violently, as if it could not withstand his pressure.
"Destroy the wrath of thunder, the mighty power!" Su Ming formed a seal with his hands, and countless rays of lightning shot out from his hands, like sharp arrows, completely covering Qin Tianba.
Qin Tianba struggled desperately in the lightning, screaming in agony. His clothes were torn to pieces by the lightning, and his skin was scorched black by the electricity. He looked extremely miserable.
"No, don't fight, I give up, I give up!" Qin Tianba finally couldn't bear it anymore and begged for mercy loudly, his voice full of fear and despair.
Su Ming's face was as cold as frost, and there was no mercy in his eyes. He said in a cold voice: "Huh, this is a life and death fight, but there is no need to beg for mercy!"
After saying that, the lightning in Su Ming's hand became more powerful, and he walked towards Qin Tianba step by step, preparing to give him the final blow.
Qin Tianba looked at Su Ming who was approaching step by step. He was so scared that he peed his pants. His legs were so weak that he couldn't even crawl. He could only collapse on the ground and look at Su Ming in horror.
At this moment, an angry voice came from the audience: "Su Ming, stop it!"
Everyone looked around and saw Qin Yangming, the head of the Qin family, standing under the stage with an angry look on his face. His eyes seemed to be spitting out fire, staring at Su Ming.
When Su Ming heard the sound, he just glanced at Qin Yangming coldly, unmoved at all, and the thunder in his hand became more violent.
"Qin Yangming, he will die today. Even if the King of Heaven comes, I can't save him!" Su Ming's voice was cold, as if coming from the Nine Nether Hell, with a sense of determination.
"How dare you! If you dare to kill him, our Qin family will definitely make your Su family's chickens and dogs uneasy!" Qin Yangming roared with rage.
A mocking smile appeared on Su Ming's lips, and he said disdainfully: "Just your Qin family? I, Su Ming, have never been afraid! "
After saying this, Su Ming no longer hesitated, and the lightning in his hand exploded, like a beam of light reaching the sky, hitting Qin Tianba hard.
"Boom! "There was a loud noise, and the arena was instantly blown to pieces, with smoke and dust filling the air and gravel flying.
When the smoke and dust dissipated, they saw that Qin Tianba had no breath and fell in the ruins, dying tragically.
When the people around him saw this scene, they were all shocked and speechless. Their eyes widened with disbelief on their faces.
Everyone in the Lin family was also shocked. The head of the Lin family looked surprised and murmured to himself: "This good-for-nothing young master of the Su family actually hides so deeply..."
